name: Pharaoh
summary: Pharaohhophra was a king of Egypt in the days of Jeremiah and Ezekiel. The LORD said He would hand him over to his enemies and break his arms before the king of Babylon.

key_moments.title: Given to His Enemies
key_moments.description: The LORD said He would hand Pharaohhophra, king of Egypt, over to his enemies. It would be just as He had handed Zedekiah of Judah over to Nebuchadrezzar.

key_moments.title: The Great Dragon
key_moments.description: The LORD told Ezekiel to prophesy against Pharaoh, the great dragon lying in his rivers, who said the river was his own and he had made it. The LORD would pull him out with hooks and leave him in the wilderness.

key_moments.title: A Broken Arm
key_moments.description: The LORD said He had broken Pharaoh's arm, and it would not be healed to hold a sword. He would make the king of Babylon strong and give him His own sword to use against Egypt.
